svg.title: Aryan Kumar, the northern realm
svg.desc: Comic cover, The Northern Realm, issue 01, @alpha730. Splash panel in pixel art: a pale heart tree with blood-red leaves and a carved face in the snow, a raven crossing the moon. Caption: Meanwhile, in the north... A speech bubble from the raven says @alpha730. Aryan Kumar in big yellow letters, and the caption AI Engineer · Earth Observation · LLM Agent Safety.
